name: Rectangular Plunge Pool with Corner Steps
headline: A finished pool that arrives in one piece.
tagline: A one-piece fiberglass shell with molded corner steps and a bench ledge. Built in the workshop, set into your ground, ready to plumb.

images.alt: Blue fiberglass pool shell sitting on grass in an open field before installation, with curved corner steps, a bench ledge inside and dark reinforcing ribs on the outside. A worker sits on the rim.
images.caption: Shell shown before rim trimming and installation

images.alt: The same model set into a garden at night, with curved corner steps, a pool light and fittings installed, before decking.
images.caption: Installed in a garden, before decking

images.alt: Front view of the installed plunge pool in a garden at night, showing the skimmer, lights and bench ledge along the walls.
images.caption: Skimmer, lights and return fittings in place

priceNote: Shell only. Delivery and installation quoted per site.

features.title: Curved corner steps
features.body: Three wide steps molded into one corner. No ladder to bolt on, nothing to rust.

features.title: Bench ledge
features.body: A seat runs along two walls for sitting in the water, watching the kids or cooling off.

features.title: Pre-cut fitting ports
features.body: Openings for return jets and lights are set in the mold, so plumbing lines up the same way on every unit.

features.title: Coping flange
features.body: The flat lip sits level with the ground and disappears under your concrete, stone or tile deck.

features.title: Ribbed exterior
features.body: Vertical reinforcing ribs on the outside stiffen the walls once the shell is backfilled.
